turns.user: List 3DCP mortars from the literature whose static yield stress after 60 minutes of rest exceeds 10 kPa.
turns.text:
I’ll check the literature database for mortar measurements at the specified rest time and distinguish reported measurements from derived estimates.
The initial search includes questionable unit conversions and a result exactly at the threshold. I’m checking the underlying records. One query failed because the schema overview used a mix-name field that differs from the actual table; I’ll correct it.

The database contains the following **3DCP mortars with static yield stress exceeding 10 kPa at a recorded rest time of 60 minutes**. These are literature measurements, including digitised experimental figures—not model predictions.

| Paper / source | Mix name in paper | Static yield stress (kPa) | Evidence |
|---|---|---:|---|
| [Matric suction of fine aggregates](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2022.127618) | 10% silica sand replacement | 13.04 | Table 2; squeeze flow |
| Same paper | 20% silica sand replacement | 18.91 | Table 2 |
| Same paper | 30% silica sand replacement | 19.86 | Table 2 |
| [Waste-glass-activated geopolymers](https://doi.org/10.1080/21650373.2025.2529994) | 50S/0F/50G | 15 | Results text; penetration |
| Same paper | 50S/20F/30G | 21 | Results text |
| Same paper | 50S/35F/15G | 34 | Results text |
| Same paper | 50S/50F | 40 | Results text |
| [One-part geopolymer mortar](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104060) | M5 | ≈47.3 | Fig. 14; penetration |
| [Bond strength between reinforcing bar and printed concrete](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.autcon.2020.103394) | Printed concrete mixture | ≈16.0 | Fig. 16; penetration |
| [Rice-husk bio-aggregate composites](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2024.111740) | RH20 / RH25 | ≈11.6 / ≈14.0 | Fig. 7b; cone penetration |
| [Heavyweight printed concrete](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.matdes.2023.112246) | M0 / M100 | ≈40.9 / ≈55.2 | Fig. 14; measured penetration series |
| [Printing in air and underwater](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2023.134403) | G1_0.40WC_0.04HEC | ≈10.7 | Fig. 6a; in air |
| Same paper | G1_0.40WC_0.06HEC | ≈17.8 / ≈14.5 | Fig. 6a/b; air / underwater |
| Same paper | G1_0.40WC_0.08HEC | ≈16.7 | Fig. 6b; underwater |
| Same paper | G2_0.40WC_0.02WLG | ≈10.7 | Fig. 6c; in air |
| Same paper | G2_0.40WC_0.04WLG | ≈17.9 | Fig. 6c; in air |
| Same paper | G2_0.40WC_0.06WLG | ≈20.2 | Fig. 6c; in air |

**Interpretation:** These are database-extracted records; the original papers were not independently rechecked. Penetration and squeeze-flow results are method-dependent. M5’s protocol includes vibration before readings, so it should not be treated as uninterrupted quiescent rest. Figure readings are approximate, particularly the overlapping air/underwater series. Records with ambiguous time definitions, calculated curves, or questionable conversions were excluded.

Tool exports: [initial literature search](</C:/Users/User/3D Printing Concrete Prediction/artifacts/reports/agent/20261016-170538-62b1/literature.csv>) and [curve-record search](</C:/Users/User/3D Printing Concrete Prediction/artifacts/reports/agent/20261016-170538-62b1/sql_1792137984.csv>). These raw exports include candidates excluded from the table.
